summary: Best combination of durable profitability, cash-backed earnings and complete scores: VRSN (9/9, gp_sector_pct 0.993, cfo 1.09B vs NI 826M), CARG (gp 1.27, cfo 295M vs NI 156M) and DPZ (gp 1.15, pct 1.0, cfo 792M vs NI 602M). Several names have earnings inside a week (VRSN, SAM, WDFC, MCO), per news_memory, and a number rely on sector labels that look wrong (DPZ, CART, HWM, MCO, MSCI), which flatters their in-sector percentile. L1 (stop anchoring) applies to proposer and portfolio-manager, not to me, so it did not shape this ranking.
